The '''Naboo Resistance''' were a group of loosely organized resistance cells created primarily by members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. Acting largely independent from each other, the groups opposed the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The groups conducted several operations during the occupation, and eventually joined forces with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] to participate in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]].

==Operations==
The [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Resistance was formed after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="PoN" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> During the course of the invasion, the Resistance set up operations in the [[Naboo airbase]] at the [[south ridge of Theed]].<ref name="SW:E1:BfN" /> A [[Naboo Resistance base|Resistance base]] was set up in the [[Naboo training canyon]], while an [[Naboo resistance base|outpost]] was [[Battle of the Naboo resistance base|attacked]].<ref name="SW:SF" /> [[Asha (Naboo)|Asha]], one of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] servants, became a leader of the Resistance and had contact with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="SW:OW" /> The resistance also had a presence in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]], and were engaged in combat with the Trade Federation forces by the time [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] [[Liberation of Spinnaker|liberated]] of the city.<ref name="SW:GB" /> At the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]], some members of the Resistance captured [[Gode Takrab]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] counterfeiter who had forged a treaty legalizing the Trade Federation's invasion.<ref name="PoN" />
